lines.1: We'd spent all of Saturday together, so today Nagomi was back home helping with the family business.
lines.2: Apparently the flower shop gets pretty busy during Obon season.
lines.3: Texting her would probably just distract her from work.
lines.4: Oh, my phone battery is almost dead.
lines.11: 「Senpai, what are you doing for lunch today?」
lines.12: 「I'll grab something at the convenience store...」
lines.13: 「...I knew it. I figured you would, so I came to cook.」
lines.14: 「I'm glad, but you should rest during your break.」
lines.15: 「I'm fine. I've got plenty of stamina.」
lines.17: 「Besides, a break is supposed to be for relaxing, right?」
lines.18: 「And being here is what relaxes me.」
lines.20: Nagomi promptly gets to work making lunch.
lines.21: ...Isn't this what they call a visiting wife?
lines.23: Lunch is somen noodles and croquettes.
lines.24: I talk with Nagomi as we eat.
lines.26: 「Oh, I've got something to do in Tokyo myself.」
lines.27: 「I should be back around three or four.」
lines.29: 「Oh, and Senpai. I packed dinner for you too, so please eat it.」
lines.31: 「Then I'll go do the laundry and everything.」
lines.34: 「You keep everything so tidy every day that there isn't much to do anyway.」
lines.35: 「I can manage that much... Right now, I just want to eat lunch and talk with you.」
lines.37: Come on, don't look so lovestruck over that...
lines.38: In the end, Nagomi stays and chats with me until the very end of her break.
lines.39: Today I'm making my first trip to Tokyo in a while.
lines.41: This is the kind of thing I enjoy more when I can look around by myself.
lines.42: Maybe Nagomi trusts me, because even when I say I'm going to Tokyo, she doesn't press me for details.
lines.43: It's not that she never asks anything... but total indifference would feel cold too.
lines.44: 「Hmm, though this bottle-ship viewing... might take a while.」
lines.45: I should text Nagomi that I'll be home tonight.
lines.47: 「Gah, right. It was almost out of power.」
lines.48: It's like noticing you're almost out of shampoo in the bath, deciding to buy more tomorrow, forgetting, and then realizing it again in the bath the next day.
lines.50: Well, Nagomi lives nearby. If I'm not home, she'll probably wait at her own place.
lines.52: 「This is bad. Bottle ships drive me mad.」
lines.53: It was already eleven at night.
lines.54: I'd been so absorbed that I even skipped dinner.
lines.55: I hope Nagomi isn't too upset.
lines.56: I'll send her an apology when I get home.
lines.57: Before that, did I have anything to eat at home?
lines.64: 「You said you'd be back at three... so I finished all the work at home by noon and came here to wait.」
lines.65: 「I couldn't reach your phone... so I just waited here.」
lines.67: 「Yes. I bought a cookbook to read, so don't worry about it.」
lines.74: Nagomi holds out her hand as instructed.
lines.75: I close it around a spare key to the house.
lines.78: 「From now on, you can wait inside.」
lines.80: 「Of course. I should've given it to you sooner.」
lines.82: Nagomi closes her fingers tightly around the key.
lines.83: ...Good thing I got to protect her before some creep could take advantage of her.
lines.84: Devotion this single-minded would be easy for someone cruel to prey upon.
lines.85: I have to look out for her.
lines.86: 「Whew, those guys haven't changed at all.」
lines.87: Today I met some old friends for tea.
lines.88: They said I'd gotten kind of mature. That made me happy.
lines.90: I gave Nagomi the spare key, so it must be her.
lines.94: 「Oh, I'm in the middle of cooking, so please excuse me.」
lines.96: ...She could've just called out from the kitchen.
lines.98: 「Mm, this is great! You really made a lot.」
lines.99: 「We'll be apart for a little while.」
lines.101: 「Oh, this simmered dish is good too. You really went all out.」
lines.102: 「We won't be able to see each other for a while.」
lines.105: 「You're only gone for two days over Obon. Aren't you being a little dramatic?」
lines.107: That was unusually direct for Nagomi.
lines.110: Then I step into my room, and what do I find?
lines.111: The bed was a wreck when I woke up, but now it's made perfectly!
lines.130: She's making no attempt to hide how annoyed she is at the interruption.
lines.131: She never looks at me that way anymore, so it almost feels nostalgic.
lines.132: 「...My mother... Hello? Yes, yes... What, right now? ...Fine.」
lines.134: 「She wants me to help clean and organize the shop... to make up for closing tomorrow.」
lines.139: 「All right, see you the day after tomorrow.」
lines.141: Nagomi heads home, glancing wistfully back at me again and again.
lines.142: I spend two sweaty days at a temporary job selling grilled eel outside a supermarket and earn twenty thousand yen.
lines.143: That should fund some fun during the second half of summer vacation.
lines.144: Nagomi comes back from the memorial service too.
lines.147: --We relax together while listening to music.
lines.148: Nagomi isn't really the type to insist that we do this or that.
lines.149: Until I suggest something, she simply stays nestled beside me in silence.
lines.153: 「Enough? We're just cuddled up listening to music.」
lines.156: 「...Oh, I need to water Otome's plants.」
lines.158: 「I should air out the unused futons tomorrow.」
lines.160: She does all the regular housework too, so I have absolutely NOTHING left to do!
lines.161: 「You... are incredibly capable for a first-year. I wish the people who wash rice with detergent could see you.」
lines.168: I pat her head some more.
lines.170: She really does love being praised.
lines.171: She's so delighted I can practically see her tail wagging.
lines.172: 「Nagomi, I'm going out for a bit.」
lines.173: 「I'll be back in about three hours.」
lines.174: 「All right. I'll take care of the housework.」
lines.175: 「...You're not going to ask where I'm going?」
lines.177: 「But I want time alone to study cooking sometimes too.」
lines.179: 「Then I'm off. We'll go out together next time.」
lines.181: ...I'm really just going to the arcade, though.
lines.182: Nagomi doesn't play those games much, so bringing her would only make her feel obliged to humor me.
lines.184: Someone challenges me while I'm playing a fighting game.
lines.185: 「...Damn, that Steep used an instant-kill combo... I lost.」
lines.186: 「Heh, still too soft. A guy who spends all his time playing with Yashi can't beat me.」
lines.188: 「Come to think of it, I haven't seen you lately. Where've you been?」
lines.189: 「Oh, I went to Tokyo for some intensive guitar practice.」
lines.190: 「Crab went on a trip with Tonfa and the others. She's getting back today too.」
lines.191: 「She should be taking a souvenir from Kansai to your place... Hasn't she shown up?」
